    user.profile.support_note = "Password reset requested by clinic admin. No impersonation was used."
    user.profile.save(update_fields=["must_reset_password", "support_note"])
metadata.proof: admin_user_support_reset() sets UserProfile.must_reset_password=True and creates a notification, but no login middleware, authentication check, or session revocation forces the user to reset their password. A compromised account can keep using existing sessions after an admin triggers a support reset. SOURCE: admin_user_support_reset stores flag → SINK: flag is never checked/enforced.

extra.message: Unbounded document uploads allow disk exhaustion

metadata.proof: document_upload() accepts files up to 5 MB each but imposes no per-user or per-session upload count limit. An authenticated attacker can automate POST requests to exhaust server storage, writing an unbounded number of files to disk. SOURCE: authenticated user uploads files → SINK: no rate limiting or upload cap on total count.
